changes.description: Added role="log", aria-live="polite", aria-label="Chat messages", tabIndex={-1} wrapper around LegendList; role="list" on LegendList; role="listitem" on each timeline row; role="status" on empty state

Added skip links (Skip to chat messages, Skip to composer); added keyboard navigation state and handlers (Arrow Up/Down to move between messages, Enter to expand/collapse, Escape to focus composer); added aria-label to scroll-to-bottom button; added id="chat-composer" to composer section
Added aria-label="Chat message composer" to form element
